Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/ucl_parser.c", "function": "ucl_parser_add_string", "line": 3061, "var": "data", "code": "return ucl_parser_add_string_priority (parser, (const unsigned char *)data, len, parser->default_priority);", "note": "Attacker-controlled raw input bytes are passed into the UCL parser as a string of length `len`."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/ucl_parser.c", "function": "ucl_parser_add_chunk_full", "line": 2951, "var": "parser->chunks", "code": "return ucl_state_machine (parser);", "note": "The input chunk is queued and dispatched to the state machine for tokenization and parsing."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/ucl_parser.c", "function": "ucl_state_machine", "line": 2576, "var": "macro->h.context_handler", "code": "ret = macro->h.context_handler (macro_start, macro_len, macro_args, parser->top_obj, macro->ud);", "note": "The parser encounters the `.inherit \"defaults\"` macro and invokes the registered context handler `ucl_inherit_handler`."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/ucl_parser.c", "function": "ucl_parse_key", "line": 1478, "var": "keylen", "code": "keylen = ucl_copy_or_store_ptr (parser, c, &nobj->trash_stack[UCL_TRASH_KEY], &key, end - c, need_unescape, ...);", "note": "The quoted key `\"aaa...\\u0000bbb...\"` is parsed; `end - c` is the raw quoted length and `need_unescape` is true, so the key is copied and unescaped."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/ucl_parser.c", "function": "ucl_copy_or_store_ptr", "line": 570, "var": "*dst", "code": "*dst = UCL_ALLOC (in_len + 1);", "note": "A buffer of `in_len + 1` bytes is allocated for the key; the raw quoted bytes are copied in, then unescaping runs in place."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/ucl_util.c", "function": "ucl_unescape_json_string", "line": 373, "var": "t[0]", "code": "t[0] = (char)uval;", "note": "The `\\u0000` escape decodes to uval=0 and writes a NUL byte into the key buffer. The function continues past it, so the returned `ret` (stored as `keylen`) is the FULL unescaped length (201), while the buffer now contains an embedded NUL after the first 100 'a' characters."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/ucl_util.c", "function": "ucl_inherit_handler", "line": 1918, "var": "parent", "code": "parent = ucl_object_lookup_len (ctx, data, len);", "note": "The `defaults` parent object is located in the context; it holds the child object whose key has `keylen=201` but an embedded NUL in its stored string."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/ucl_util.c", "function": "ucl_inherit_handler", "line": 1949, "var": "copy", "code": "copy = ucl_object_copy (cur);", "note": "Each child of the parent is deep-copied via `ucl_object_copy`, which calls `ucl_object_copy_internal`."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/ucl_util.c", "function": "ucl_object_copy_internal", "line": 3598, "var": "new->trash_stack[UCL_TRASH_KEY]", "code": "new->trash_stack[UCL_TRASH_KEY] = strdup (other->trash_stack[UCL_TRASH_KEY]);", "note": "The key is duplicated with `strdup`, which stops at the embedded NUL, allocating only 101 bytes (100 'a' + NUL). The copied object's `keylen` field is still 201 (copied via memcpy from the source object)."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/ucl_util.c", "function": "ucl_inherit_handler", "line": 1951, "var": "copy->key / copy->keylen", "code": "ucl_object_insert_key (target, copy, copy->key, copy->keylen, false);", "note": "The copied object is inserted into the target object using the 101-byte key buffer but the full `keylen=201`."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "src/ucl_util.c", "function": "ucl_object_insert_key", "line": 2527, "var": "key / keylen", "code": "return ucl_object_insert_key_common (top, elt, key, keylen, copy_key, false, false);", "note": "Forwards the mismatched key pointer and keylen to the common insertion routine."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "src/ucl_util.c", "function": "ucl_object_insert_key_common", "line": 2424, "var": "top->value.ov", "code": "top->value.ov = ucl_hash_insert_object (top->value.ov, elt, false);", "note": "The object is inserted into the target's hash table, which will hash the key using the oversized keylen."},
  {"step": 13, "file": "src/ucl_internal.h", "function": "ucl_hash_insert_object", "line": 486, "var": "obj", "code": "if (!ucl_hash_insert (nhp, obj, obj->key, obj->keylen)) {", "note": "Calls `ucl_hash_insert` with the copied object whose key buffer is 101 bytes but keylen is 201."},
  {"step": 14, "file": "src/ucl_hash.c", "function": "ucl_hash_insert", "line": 333, "var": "obj", "code": "k = kh_put (ucl_hash_node, h, obj, &ret);", "note": "The khash insert macro computes the bucket index by hashing the object, invoking `ucl_hash_func`."},
  {"step": 15, "file": "src/ucl_hash.c", "function": "kh_put_ucl_hash_node", "line": 117, "var": "o", "code": "KHASH_INIT (ucl_hash_node, const ucl_object_t *, struct ucl_hash_elt *, 1, ucl_hash_func, ucl_hash_equal)", "note": "The khash-generated put function calls the hash function `ucl_hash_func` on the object to locate the insertion bucket."},
  {"step": 16, "file": "src/ucl_hash.c", "function": "ucl_hash_func", "line": 105, "var": "o->key / o->keylen", "code": "return mum_hash (o->key, o->keylen, ucl_hash_seed ());", "note": "Hashes the 101-byte key buffer using the oversized keylen=201, passing both to `mum_hash`."},
  {"step": 17, "file": "src/mum.h", "function": "mum_hash", "line": 406, "var": "key / len", "code": "return _mum_hash_avx2 (key, len, seed);", "note": "Dispatches to the AVX2 hash routine with the 101-byte buffer and len=201."},
  {"step": 18, "file": "src/mum.h", "function": "_mum_hash_avx2", "line": 292, "var": "key / len", "code": "return _mum_final (_mum_hash_aligned (seed + len, key, len));", "note": "Calls `_mum_hash_aligned` with the full len=201, which will read 8-byte words across the whole declared length."},
  {"step": 19, "file": "src/mum.h", "function": "_mum_hash_aligned", "line": 230, "var": "((uint64_t *) str)[i]", "code": "result ^= _mum (_mum_le (((uint64_t *) str)[i]), _mum_primes[i]);", "note": "The 8-byte read at offset 200 (past the 101-byte heap buffer) triggers the heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 8, crashing in ASAN."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written"; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid JSON, steps:', len(d))"
